Acme Employee Handbook

Working hours and leave

Full-time employees work 40 hours per week. Core hours are 10:00 to 15:00, when everyone is expected to be available for meetings. Outside core hours, you may arrange your day with your manager.

Annual leave is 25 days per year and accrues monthly. You may carry over up to 5 unused days into the next year, and carried-over days must be used by 31 March or they expire.

Sick leave is 10 paid days per year. A doctor's note is required after 3 consecutive days of absence. Parental leave is 16 weeks, fully paid, for each parent.Remote work and equipment

Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week with their manager's approval. Fully remote employees receive a co-working allowance of 100 USD per month.

New employees receive a home office stipend of 400 USD, available once every 2 years, for a desk, chair or monitor. Laptops are refreshed every 36 months.

When working from a cafe, airport or any public Wi-Fi network, you must connect through the company VPN before opening internal systems.Expenses and travel

Submit expense reports within 30 days of the purchase. A receipt is required for every expense above 25 USD. Reports older than 30 days may be rejected.

Book economy class for flights shorter than 6 hours. The hotel limit is 180 USD per night, and the meal per diem is 60 USD per day. Mileage for personal cars is reimbursed at 0.50 USD per mile.

Any single expense above 500 USD needs written approval from a director before you spend it.
